reviews.title: Great product
reviews.body: These work well 34 inches is hitting the top of length I would use for these, but I needed a countertop height. They are strong and solid, but due to the nature of the product, it can be a little wobbly at that height. I do have other pairs that are shorter that are more solid. Overall build quality is great. They are as advertised highly recommend.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 2, 2026
reviews.author: Erin sullivan

reviews.title: Super Satisfied!
reviews.body: Loved how it turned out. Broke down my old broken coffee table and decided to try and make an entry table for myself. I thought it might have been too tall (which would have been my fault) but I really like the size and style. The legs are sturdy and the rubber bottoms help keep it from sliding around. The screws were a little too long for the wood I used, but I was able to buy shorter ones which wasn’t a big deal. I love that the screws they provided were black so it would blend seamlessly into the metal and they provide more than the amount needed. Great quality for the price!

features: RELIABLE TABLE LEGS: The hairpin table leg is made of carbon steel. Three-rod design makes it much more stable. The leg takes powder coating craft, which makes it anti-rust & smooth on the surface.

HEAVY DUTY CAPACITY: Each of the desk legs can hold Max. 220 lbs load. So the four legs together can carry up a weight of 880 lbs. They are stronger than other two rods hairpin table legs. It is heavy-duty and solid enough meet your needs.
THOUGHTFUL DESIGN: We offer four rubber cover. Use them to protect floors from scratches or other damage. In addition, they also have a good anti-slip effect.

SIMPLE INSTALLATION: The 4.3"x4.3" mounting plate has four φ6 mm pre-drilled holes and we offer enough screws. You only need to use an screwdriver to fix the screws into the wooden plate. So, the installation is quick and time-saving.

VARIOUS APPLICATION: The hairpin table legs are suitable for many kinds of DIY designs, such as desks, benches, and other piece of furniture. You can use the legs to decorate different kinds of furniture of your home, garden and corridor. Take them to make your home more fashionable and modern.
